intro: Canopy at Hudson Bend is the newest gated community on the Hudson Bend peninsula, with about 50 CastleRock homes and nearly all of them sold. CleanzATX gives new owners their first proper window cleaning, with Tyler Durham quoting each home.

sections.h2: What Canopy at Hudson Bend homes are like
paragraphs: Canopy is a gated new build community by CastleRock, with about 50 homes, and it is close to sold out. Prices run from $775K to $900K, which makes it one of the easier ways to buy a newer home on the peninsula. The Canopy at Hudson Bend HOA looks after the community.

Everything here is recent. Sod is new, trees are young and the homes still have the crisp look of a build that finished not long ago. Many of the neighbors moved in within the same year or two, so they tend to ask the same questions about upkeep. It is a good place to start a cleaning habit while the windows are still in good shape.

sections.h2: What Canopy at Hudson Bend windows deal with
paragraphs: New construction leaves a mark on glass. Fine drywall dust, paint specks, stickers, adhesive and stucco splatter can all end up on windows and frames. Pure water removes the loose dirt and pollen right away. Stubborn bits need careful hand work, and we tell you before we start whether any will remain.

Young landscapes also need lots of watering, so new sprinklers throw hard water onto lower windows daily. White spots show up in a matter of weeks. That is a good time to book spot removal at $10 per pane, before it sets into the glass. Building continues nearby, so construction dust keeps arriving too.

sections.h2: How we work Canopy at Hudson Bend
paragraphs: Because of the gate, we need a code or a contact on the day. After that, a visit is quick: lots are compact compared with the big acre estates nearby, so we work from the ground with water fed poles and move house to house if neighbors book together. A new home is a good time to start a plan, since regular cleaning keeps minerals from building up.
For a home around 2,400 sq ft, exterior windows come to about $240 at $0.10 per sq ft. Expect roughly an hour and three quarters to two and a half hours on site for the outside.

faq.q: My home was just built. Is it too soon to clean?
faq.a: Not at all. Construction dust, pollen and sprinkler spots arrive right away. A first cleaning also lets us see whether any build residue needs extra attention. We can also check that the builder cleaning missed nothing.

faq.q: Can you remove paint or sticker marks?
faq.a: Light marks often come off by hand. Heavy paint or adhesive needs a careful look, and we will tell you what we can safely remove before starting so we do not scratch your glass.

faq.q: Who opens the gate for you?
faq.a: Send us the code or the name of a contact who can let us in when you book. We confirm the day by text and handle the rest.

faq.q: What should a new home budget?
faq.a: Exterior windows are $10 each or about $0.10 per sq ft, with a $200 minimum. The inside and outside together are $15 per window. Screens are $5 each. Our quote arrives by text, typically inside the hour on weekdays. We do not add trip fees inside the neighborhood.

faq.q: Is a plan worth it for a new home?
faq.a: Many new owners pick Twice a Year at 10% off or Triannual at 15% off. Triannual includes hard water removal on up to 5 windows per visit and a free screen cleaning each year.
